help.stdout:
usage: gnd review [-h] {panel,panel-light,finalize} ...

Advisory multi-CLI review over ONE of exactly three input classes — a plan, an
experiment outcome, or a spec/results/delta bundle. GND attempts six reviewer
seats over five installed terminal-agent CLIs (claude, codex, qwen, gemini,
kimi, plus a glm seat that runs the claude CLI against Z.AI's Anthropic-
compatible endpoint) through fixed Python-owned invocation argv and bounded
prompt transport (stdin for five, one --prompt argv element for Kimi), keeps
one closed envelope per reviewer including every timeout, authentication
failure, missing executable and unparseable response, and requires three
DISTINCT schema-valid successes before any panel result may be reported. Every
reviewer must first return substantive help that documents every long flag in
the invocation GND is about to send; an incompatible reviewer is never
invoked. GND does not sandbox reviewer CLIs or enforce read-only execution. It
verifies the reviewed artifacts are unchanged before publishing a run. The
panel ships no provider SDK and sources no credentials.

positional arguments:
  {panel,panel-light,finalize}
    panel               attempt all six reviewers and publish one immutable
                        evidence directory
    panel-light         run the same panel at high or medium supported per-run
                        effort
    finalize            validate a semantic synthesis against immutable run
                        evidence and render it

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
